## Progress

- Merged [PR #58](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/58): `POST /v1/patients/search` (text in the body only, rows show initials/age/sex/MRN tail, exact phone/MRN/ABHA/EID via deterministic Always Encrypted, partial numbers refused, per-user rate limit) and `GET /v1/patients/{id}`; capability policy from the active membership, one audit event per request (Denied too), facility scope; clinic header search, directory with filters and paging, record page, en/hi/ar RTL, axe clean
- [PR #70](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/70) (in review): review fixes — national/insurance numbers masked to the last 4 with an audited reveal (Full access), per-user limit on record opens and paging capped at 50 pages, separator-only and 0091-phone queries, focus kept and one live status region while paging, facility-local registration date; p95 measured through the endpoints with 50,000 encrypted ABHAs (search 105–226 ms, duplicate check 16 ms locally); 9 mutations each caught
- Follow-ups outside this ticket: read-volume alert with the practice access log (MDV-P1-035); cross-facility patients within a tenant (P7); doctor ⌘K overlay (D-02, P2)

## Description

Search by name, MRN, phone, ABHA/EID (exact). Results show initials, age, sex and MRN tail until a record is opened; opening a record is audited with purpose "registration/booking". Directory list with filters (incomplete registration, recently registered) and pagination. Deterministic Always Encrypted columns support exact ID lookups.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Searching by full phone number or exact EID/ABHA returns the matching patient(s); partial ID search is not allowed.
- [ ] **AC2.** Result rows show only initials, age, sex and MRN tail; full demographics appear only after opening, which writes an audit event.
- [ ] **AC3.** Empty state: "No patients match. Register a new patient".
- [ ] **AC4.** Search p95 < 300 ms with 50,000 synthetic patients; endpoint rate-limited.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
